map.：q = k*A*ΔT/d（热流 W）。墙 k=0.04W/mK、A=10m2、: : q = k*A*deltaT/d (heat flux W). Wall k=0.04W/mK, A=10m2, thickness 0.2m, inside-outside difference 20K: q = 0.04*10*20/0.2 = 40W. Thicker or lower k reduces heat flux.

map.散热件要 k 大（快导热），保温件要 k 小（如岩棉、气凝胶）；看用途。: Heat sinks need large k (fast conduction), insulators need small k (e.g. rock wool, aerogel); depends on use.
map.中间空气层 k 极小且阻断对流，总热阻大增，传热远低于单层玻璃。: The middle air layer has very small k and blocks convection, greatly increasing total thermal resistance; heat transfer is far lower than single glazing.
